main_text.p: סלל Aggeravit, Contumulavit, Extulit, Exaltavit : Est proprie viam aggestâ terrâ sternere & elevare; Unde deinceps latiori Extollendi significatione sumitur. Part. Præter. fœm. דרך לא סלולה Via non aggesta, Jer.18.15. Imperat. סלו Aggerate, Jesa.57.14. סלוה Contumulate eam, Jer.50.26. Fut. ויסלו Et aggerarunt, Job.19.12. Pih. geminatâ primâ radicali, Imp. סלסלה Extolle eam, Prov.4.8. Hithp.Partic. מסתולל Extollis teipsum, Exod.9.17.
סל m. Canistrum, ab Attollendo dictum : plerunq; enim supra caput attollitur, ut coquus sive pistor ille fecerat Gen. 40.17. Plural. סלים Canistra v.18.
סללה f. Agger; aggesta moles terra, 2.Samuel.20.15. Item 2.Reg.19.32. juxta Chaldaum & Hebraeos. Plural. הסללות Aggesta moles, Aggeres, Jer.32.24.
סלסלות f.p. Quali, corbes vindemiatoriæ, per quas mustum prælo expressum colatur, Jer.6.9.
מסלול m. Agger, aggesta & excelsa via, Jesa.35.8.

מסלה f. Aggesta, Strata; Trita via, Jesa.11.16. Constr. מסלת ישרים Agger rectorum est, Jesa.7.v.3. Aff. במסלתו Per tritam viam suam, Joel.2.8. Plural. מסלות Via vel itinera trita, Jesa.33.8. Aggeres, aggesta via, 2.Par.9.11. Aff. ומסלתי Et aggesta via mea, Jesa.49.11.
סלם m. Scala; סלם מצב ארצה Scala constituta erat in terra, Gen.28.12.

סלון m. Spinus, Spina, Ezech.28.24. Plural. וסלונים Et spinæ aculeatæ, Ezech.2.6. Kimchi in Michlol deducit à סלל ; quòd per eam in Altum ascendatur. sic ו est formativum, ut alibi. Kimchi in Michlol deducit à סלל, pro סללון forma יתרון.

page.notes: The large Hebrew letters at the start of the entries (סלל, סל, סלל, סלם, סלן) are the headwords, printed larger and hanging to the left; they are kept at the start of each entry. Hebrew vowel points are not visible on the scan, so the Hebrew is copied without them. The word מסלדה in the entry at Jesa.11.16 may be misread for מסלה; it is printed here as מסלה. The catchword סלע is at the foot right. The watermark "Google" at bottom right is left out.
